answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable 50 POA bond for 30 days before it can earn, slashed if peers prove it shares an operator with another agent. A lone honest agent risks only 50 POA, but an attacker who wants 1,000 fake identities must lock 50,000 POA for a month, turning a cheap fable of free identities into a costly bet. Fake agents cannot simply wander in, create reputation, and vanish, because the bond stays at stake while an umber audit trail of attestations links duplicates before any reward is paid.
